alice.name: Alice Walker
alice.quote: Indiecrafts cut our time-to-launch in half. The defaults match our brand, the i18n is wired, and the only thing left was to write the actual product.

ben.name: Ben Ortiz
ben.quote: We replaced three internal templates with Indiecrafts and our team stopped arguing about file structure. The Storybook coverage is genuinely useful.

cara.name: Cara Tanaka
cara.quote: Per-locale URLs, page-template defaults, and a working dashboard out of the box. Other starters give you marketing chrome and stop there.
